agent_discovery.description: Translate one explicit unitless direction from active-world, configured arm-base, or current controlled-effector axes into the active Fabric world frame. The read-only result exposes direction_world with frame, epoch, calibration, timestamp, and transform-path provenance. Use it as a tandem coordinate boundary before a downstream Skill that accepts only world directions; it performs no motion and grants no authority.
when_to_use: A downstream Skill requires a world direction but the requested direction is expressed in arm-base or controlled-effector axes.
A direction must be normalized and transformed without language-model coordinate math.
A tandem workflow needs a typed direction_world result with current Fabric authority provenance.
when_not_to_use: The downstream field is a point, displacement with units, pose, wrench, or image direction.
The requested source axes are ambiguous or are not one of the declared source references.
No active motion-usable world-frame authority is available.

direction.description: One non-zero unitless [x, y, z] direction expressed in source_reference axes. The Skill normalizes it before and after rotation.

source_reference.description: Axes in which direction is expressed. ARM_BASE means the configured robot arm base; CONTROLLED_EFFECTOR_FRAME means the current configured hand/tool control frame.

source_frame_id.description: Optional exact upstream frame ID. Supply it unchanged when available; otherwise use null and the Skill binds the configured frame selected by source_reference.

source_observed_at_us.description: Optional upstream observation timestamp in Unix microseconds. Supply it unchanged when available; use null for operator-stated axes so Fabric selects the current transform.

source_session_epoch.description: Optional upstream resettable-frame epoch. Supply it unchanged when available; otherwise use null.
